title: The Declaration of Interplanetary Independence
description: An affectionate parody of the grand historical painting of the signing of the Declaration of Independence in Independence Hall: dignified eighteenth-century delegates debate the parchment while a perfectly serious Space Ghost arrives late carrying a giant souvenir fountain pen, and tiny Zorak sneaks a biscuit from the ceremonial table. Golden candlelight melts into violet shadows.
